default_state.comment: Default ClientState assigned to clients upon connection.

READYRUN_start_node.comment: In READYRUN ServerState: ClientState for the starting node of a Course.

READYRUN_no_triggers_done.comment: In READYRUN ServerState: initial ClientState for all participating nodes of a Course (excluding the starting node).

READYRUN_some_triggers_done.comment: In READYRUN ServerState: ClientState for all participating nodes of a course which have some, but not all, of their required touches completed.

READYRUN_all_triggers_done.comment: In READYRUN ServerState: ClientState for all participating nodes of a course which have all of their required touches completed.

READYRUN_not_in_course.comment: In READYRUN ServerState: ClientState for all non-participating nodes of a Course.

DEFINE_not_in_course.comment: In DEFINE ServerState: Initial ClientState for nodes, indicating they have not been added to the course.

DEFINE_in_course.comment: In DEFINE ServerState: ClientState for a node which has been added to the course, but is not the currently selected node.

DEFINE_selected_node.comment: In DEFINE ServerState: ClientState for the actively selected node (nominally, the most-recently-added node).

FINISHED_successful_run.comment: In FINISHED ServerState, upon successful course completion: ClientState for all nodes.
